'''''Leaving''''' is part of the title of three chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series:

* ''[[New Spring/Chapter 4|Leaving the Tower]]'' - the forth chapter of ''[[New Spring]]''.
* ''[[Winter's Heart/Chapter 1|Leaving the Prophet]]'' - the first chapter of ''[[Winter's Heart]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 9|Leaving Malden]]'' - the ninth chapter of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.

==See also==
*''[[Leavetaking]]'' - the title of four chapters in the series.
